items.summary_en: A group collecting 3,000 signatures against plans to turn a former RAF base in Linton-on-Ouse, North Yorkshire, into an asylum seeker centre had its House of Commons petition rejected. Officials turned it down because it requested action at a local level. The group's spokesperson called the decision ridiculous, saying the scheme is part of national government policy.
